incidents.name: AurumNodePool unprotected parameter setters
incidents.notes: AurumNodePool.changeNodePrice() and changeRewardPerNode() had no permission check, so the attacker set an arbitrary reward per node, created a node and claimed it.

sources.ref: onchain review: AurumNodePool 0x70678291bDDfd95498d1214BE368e19e882f7614 created 2022-06-21T15:33:18Z by 0x01976b2c219b41149310af8149b0f87bc077bb0b, unrelated to attack sender 0x6903499751f973052155df339116b6c6b24ac24b; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The attack spanned two transactions (0xb3bc6ca2... sets the parameters and claims, 0x7f031e85... sells the AUR for 49.93 WBNB); lossUsd uses the ~$13k reported by DeFiHackLabs.
